name: Galaxy A26 5G

Network.SIM: Single SIM (Nano-SIM) or Dual SIM (Nano-SIM, dual stand-by)

Body.Dimensions: 164 mm H , 77.5 mm W , 7.7 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 15 with One UI 7, Current: Android 17 with One UI 9
Platform.Chipset: Exynos 1380 (5nm) (all except Latin America), Exynos 1280 (5nm) (Latin America)
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (2x2.4 GHz Cortex-A78 & 6x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55) (Exynos 1280), Octa-core (4x2.4 GHz Cortex-A78 & 4x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55) (Exynos 1380)

Display.Display: 6.7 in, Infinity-U Display, 1080 x 2340 px resolution, 19.5:9 ratio (~385 ppi density), Super AMOLED, 120Hz refresh rate

Cameras.Rear camera: Triple-Camera Setup, Primary: Samsung ISOCELL (S5K)JN1; 50 Megapixel, MP, f/1.8, 27mm, FoV 78.4°, 1/2.76", 0.64 μm, PDAF, OIS, Ultrawide: Samsung ISOCELL (S5K)4HA; 8 Megapixel, MP, f/2.2, 16mm, FoV 108.7°, 1/4.0", 1.12 μm, Macro: GalaxyCore GC02M1; 2 Megapixel, MP, f/2.4, 1/5.0", 1.75 μm, Camera features: LED flash, panorama, HDR, Video recording: 4K resolution, 4K@30fps, 1080p@30fps, 720p@480fps, gyro-EIS
Cameras.Front camera: Hynix Hi-1339; 13 Megapixel, MP, f/2.2, 25mm (wide), FoV 80.6°, 1/3.06", 1.12 μm, Video recording: 1080p@30fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth 5.3, A2DP, LE, GPS, GALILEO, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS, NFC
